Team —

- Confirm executive sponsor mapping (who will be the customer exec + our exec liaison for each EB slot).
- Approve the proposed EB meeting slots in the attachment (I added 3 candidate windows).
- Finalize the evaluation milestones in the MAP so we can push procurement to sign the SOW the week after the EB.

I've attached: Pioneer_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), Pioneer_EB_slots.ics (proposed EB times), redwood-one-pager.pdf (customer-facing one-pager).

Please review and reply with: 1) confirmed internal exec liaison per slot, 2) any redlines to milestone dates, 3) any blockers for SOC2 evidence.

Thanks —
